lead_raw_text:
The structure of NdGa2Se4 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 119), with 14 atoms per unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ga centers coordinated by six Se neighbors, alongside seven-coordinate Nd centers surrounded by seven Se neighbors. The Ga octahedra show corner-sharing with each other and with the Nd polyhedra, while Nd–Nd polyhedra display corner- and face-sharing. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
